## Install

The toolkit ships as a single static binary. Pick the method that fits your platform.

## macOS

```bash
brew install example-toolkit
example --version
```

If you use `MacPorts`, run `sudo port install example` instead.

## Linux

| Distro | Command |
| --- | --- |
| Debian | `apt install example` |
| Fedora | `dnf install example` |

> [!note] Note
> Root is not required for the user install.

### Verify the install

1. Open a new shell.
2. Run example doctor.
3. Confirm all checks pass.
